scope: Static selected source inputs using the pinned original Store repoCatalog and partPaths; no builders, apps, installers or target SDK executed.

working_tree_observation.file_selection: git cached and nonignored untracked regular files; Store metadata skips, Python/test caches, README and both refreshed readiness reports excluded
working_tree_observation.whole_repository_bytes_note: Report/document outputs excluded; this does not reduce the known whole-repository budget blocker.

limits_of_evidence: Input byte counts do not measure peak build usage, generated output, SDK extraction, or downloaded assets.
Positive input evidence is not a successful compile, emulator run, head-unit installation, registration, or functional test.
All unit-build and live-installation results are NOT_OBSERVED.
A source fetch or build failure may cause Store to retry the whole repository, which exceeds the default build byte budget in this observation.
